title: Odisha Arts & Literature Calendar
scope: Events physically in Odisha. Programme sources are separate from dated editions. No claim of exhaustive district coverage.

events.title: 8th Odisha State Book Festival
events.description: Books and publishers at IDCO Exhibition Ground, Unit-3. Organised by the Odia Language, Literature & Culture Department.
events.note: Stall reservation deadline: 16 November 2026. Visitor hours, admission and daily programme are not specified in the notice.

events.title: Puri Literary Festival
events.description: Literature, art and heritage at Taj Puri Resort & Spa, as announced on the festival website.
events.note: The dated header announces 2026; some registration and programme text still refers to 2025. Confirm current registration and programme with the organiser.

events.title: Kalinga Literary Festival
events.date_label: 19–21 March 2027 · latest organiser post; reconfirm opening
events.description: The organiser’s public invitation posted on 13 October 2026 gives 19–21 March 2027 for the 13th edition in Bhubaneswar.
events.note: Earlier organiser letters give 18–21 March. The newer social post does not explicitly explain the change; confirm whether 18 March has a separate opening programme before booking.

events.title: Rajdhani Book Fair
events.description: An October report announces a fair at the Exhibition Ground following an organising committee meeting.
events.note: An organiser-issued 2026 notice is still needed. Dates are reported, not independently confirmed with the organiser.

events.title: Odisha Literary Festival · The New Indian Express
events.description: The 14th edition brought literature, publishing and arts conversations to Mayfair Convention.
events.note: 2026 edition completed; next edition not verified.

events.title: Toshali Literature Festival
events.description: Udayagiri Foundation’s literary festival includes poetry and the Jayanta Mahapatra National Award for Literature.
events.note: The organiser’s 2026 schedule supplies these dates, although the page title still mentions 2025. The Ranch, Mangalpur, is listed for the edition. Next-edition dates are not verified. Separate from the Toshali crafts mela.

events.title: Parichaya National Literary Festival
events.description: A multilingual festival for poets, translators and writers. The reported fourth edition took place on 15–16 November 2025.
events.note: Historical venue: Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra Odissi Research Centre. Do not reuse the 2025 dates for 2026.

events.title: Shri Kshetra National Literary Festival
events.description: The fifth edition was reported at Gita Govinda Bhavan and Jayadev Bhavan, with multilingual poetry, translation and storytelling.
events.note: Name does not establish a Puri venue; the reported 2026 event was in Bhubaneswar.

events.title: Odisha Art & Literature Festival
events.description: Art World’s 11th Odisha Art & Literature Festival is reported for three days in Bhubaneswar, including recognition of young Odia poets.
events.note: Dates are stated in the 29 September OdishaPlus report. A dated organiser programme, precise venue and attendance arrangements still need confirmation.

events.title: Koraput LitFest · Odia Media
events.description: Odia Media’s literary festival, documented in the publisher’s Jaipur BookMark rights catalogue.
events.note: Distinct from Kalinga Literary Festival’s Koraput initiative. Previous editions have also included Bhubaneswar; confirm the actual venue.

events.title: Bhubaneswar LitFest · Odia Media
events.description: Odia Media lists this festival alongside Koraput LitFest in its publisher profile.
events.note: Identity documented; current dates, venue and programme remain unverified.

events.title: KLF in Koraput
events.description: An initiative connecting indigenous literatures, oral storytelling, folklore and wider literary dialogue.
events.note: The organiser page describes April 2018. It does not announce a new edition. Distinct from Odia Media’s similarly named festival.

events.title: Kandhamal Literary Festival
events.description: KLF’s initiative exploring the relationships between indigenous literature, nature and culture.
events.note: Series identity is documented; no current in-person dates or venue established. Earlier virtual activity does not establish a physical event.

events.title: BhuFeSto · Bhubaneswar Festival of Storytelling
events.description: Bakul Foundation and BDA’s oral storytelling festival brings storytellers and folk performers into city parks.
events.note: The organiser page retains a 2024 announcement; no new dates inferred.

events.title: KLF Corner
events.description: The organiser describes a monthly literary series at Oxford Bookstore.
events.note: Monthly is the series description, not confirmation of any particular upcoming session. Check the next announcement.

events.title: Kalinga Book Fair
events.description: A separate book fair whose organiser website provides the 28th edition’s brochure and participation documents.
events.note: Website dates are 21–30 November 2025. They are not confirmed 2026 dates; distinct from the state festival and Rajdhani fair.

events.title: Sambalpur Book Fair
events.description: NBT, SETU and the district administration organised the 26th edition, combining books and cultural programmes.
events.note: 2026 edition completed. Next dates not verified.

events.title: Rourkela Pustak Mahotsav
events.description: Bhanja Cultural Trust, in association with SAIL Rourkela Steel Plant, organised the book festival at Bhanja Bhavan, Sector-5.
events.note: 2026 edition completed; next dates not verified.

events.title: Cuttack Sahitya Sarobar
events.description: A district book fair at Bali Yatra Ground, jointly organised by CMC, CDA and the state government, according to contemporary reporting.
events.note: The report describes a ten-day fair inaugurated on 20 March. Exact closing date and next edition require an official notice.

events.title: Chilika Book Fair
events.description: The inaugural fair was announced for Balugaon College, bringing publishers and readers to the Chilika region.
events.note: Historical announced dates; completion was not independently checked. No annual recurrence assumed.

events.title: Kalinga Art Festival
events.description: The tenth art festival was announced alongside KLF 2026, featuring painters, sculptors and visual storytelling.
events.note: Part of the KLF programme, not an additional independent trip. Next art-edition dates are not inferred from KLF 2027.

events.title: International Dhauli Art Festival
events.description: Dhauli College of Art & Crafts’ seventh festival was reported with collaborative painting and children’s activities.
events.note: Distinct from the Dhauli-Kalinga performing arts festival. Next edition unverified.

events.title: UNURUM · Art, Literature & Culture
events.description: Fakir Mohan University’s international literary, cultural and art festival celebrates indigenous heritage at its Balasore campus.

sources.label: University website · links to the Instagram account

events.note: Dates confirmed in the university’s public Instagram announcement on 14 October; the account is linked from its official website. Daily programme and visitor-entry arrangements should be checked with the university.

events.title: Utsha · exhibitions, talks & open studios
events.description: Utsha Foundation for Contemporary Art hosts residencies, discussions, film screenings and other creative programmes at Unit-6.
events.note: No dated public exhibition or talk was found in the checked events page. The homepage advertises a 2026 residency open call, but the application page says applications are closed; confirm availability directly.

events.title: Lalit Kala Akademi · Bhubaneswar exhibitions
events.description: The Akademi’s event record includes the Bhubaneswar regional centre’s Metamorphosis exhibition on 24 July 2026.
events.note: Use individual regional-centre announcements for exhibition duration, access and opening hours.

events.title: Toshali National Crafts Mela / Toshali Swadeshi Mela
events.description: The 20th Toshali Swadeshi Mela brought handicrafts, handloom and cultural performances to Janata Maidan, Bhubaneswar.
events.note: Dates come from the operational partner’s post-event account and contemporary news. Earlier tender dates were 13–25 February; those are superseded here by the account of the event held. Next edition not verified.

events.title: Adivasi Mela
events.description: ATLC’s fair presents tribal art, craft and cultural programmes. Its 2026 planning document specifies Unit-I Exhibition Ground.
events.note: 2026 procurement document planned eleven days from 26 January. This is historical planning evidence, not a 2027 announcement.

events.title: Kala Bhoomi · craft workshops & performances
events.description: SIDAC notices document workshop programming and classical and folk dance activity at the Odisha Crafts Museum.
events.note: Artist empanelment and participation notices do not guarantee a visitor session every week. Confirm the next public programme.

events.title: ODI ART · workshops & cultural programmes
events.description: The folk and tribal art centre hosts workshops and cultural activity, as described by Odisha Tourism.
events.note: Venue programme source. No particular upcoming workshop or festival date verified.

events.title: Mayurbhanj Living Heritage Festival
events.description: A reason to spend time with craft practitioners and performance, then explore Mayurbhanj beyond a single stop.
events.note: Confirm entry, workshop places and the daily programme. Venue status does not establish available rooms or a festival accommodation package.

events.title: Konark Festival
events.description: Make classical dance the centre of a coastal journey, with time to look closely at Konark’s architecture.
events.note: Check performance tickets, programme, venue access and late-evening transport. A temple visit has its own arrangements.

events.title: International Sand Art Festival
events.description: A possible daylight arts stop alongside a Konark dance trip, once both editions and their schedules are confirmed.
events.note: Confirm edition year, installation days, visitor hours and weather arrangements. The generic calendar is not a ticket confirmation.

events.title: Parab
events.description: Start with an invited public cultural programme, then make room for the wider Koraput landscape and its contemporary communities.
events.note: Obtain the District Council of Culture programme: village/block activities and the finale may have different dates and venues. Regional stays are not necessarily near the festival.

events.title: Mystic Kalinga
events.description: Poetry and performance associated with Kalinga Literary Festival.
events.note: Listed as a simultaneous event in the KLF 2026 ticket page; a new standalone edition is not confirmed.

events.title: Literary Forum · Odia Poetry Reading
events.description: Sahitya Akademi and Koraput Sahitya Paribar announced an Odia poetry reading at the Tribal Museum.
events.note: Historical programme; not a recurring weekly event.

events.title: Voice of Harmony · Odisha’s legacy institutions
events.description: Sahitya Akademi and Utkal Sahitya Samaj announced a seminar at Satabdi Bhawan, Town Hall Road.
events.note: A dated seminar within the wider literary scene; future programmes require fresh announcements.

events.title: Yuva Sahiti · young Sanskrit poets
events.description: Sahitya Akademi’s young-poet programme was announced at Raja Madhusudan Dev Degree College.
events.note: Historical programme; no new dates inferred.

research_notes: State book festival: government edition notice overrides generic tourism listing of 6–17 December.
Puri: 2026 header retained; old registration text explicitly caveated.
KLF: latest direct organiser post (13 October 2026) gives 19–21 March 2027; earlier 18–21 March letters retained as an unresolved opening-day discrepancy.
Odia Media Koraput LitFest and KLF in Koraput are distinct organiser identities.
Toshali literature and crafts festivals are distinct.
No dates rolled into a future year. News-only dates clearly labelled. Past announcements do not prove actual occurrence.

Second date review on 14 October 2026 recovered UNURUM via the university-linked Instagram account, OALF via the full news report, and past Toshali literature/crafts dates. No annual dates inferred for undated editions.
